status: Early M1 presentation;12ce contract plus announced neutral naming, final implementation/samples pending

draft.title: Route preview
draft.hint: Right-click sets the destination. Shift + right-click adds a waypoint.
draft.costs: Returned per-leg and total costs; crossing count separate; unavailable total for incomplete route
draft.persistence: Local review draft only if explicit host contract is supplied; never mutate generated map JSON or campaign saves
draft.failure: Retain user queue, show failed leg/index reason, no prefix/cost/current line from failed result

markers.automaticTransitNodes: No numbered markers, visit rings or survey effects
markers.overlap: Ordered inspector plus zoom, no geometry displacement or renumbering

line.baseline: Initial centreless ordered shared-edge midpoint chain only; explicit start/end/user anchors retained, no automatic centre returns
line.smoothing: Later separately verified scope; initial result is not globally taut/shortest/minimum-bend
line.failure: Show actual invalid leg reason without bridging or silently skipping it
line.perLeg: Paint each leg with explicit shared waypoint anchors; A->B->A retains P->B->P, never flattened P->P
line.repeatedTargets: Preserve ordered duplicate targets and zero-length legs; no global vertex dedup erasing user pins

intent.transit: Corridor or user-pinned transit anchor; no POI action implied
intent.starLocation: A chosen position is not an explicit visit/survey command
intent.visitAction: No visit/scout/action semantics. Announced SystemLocation(value2) requires associated SystemId and is a location draft only.
intent.automaticSystemRegion: Passing through its region does not pin its star

comparisons.drawing: Same actual corridor, anchors, nodes and costs; centre-return versus contained transit
comparisons.tieChoice: Fixed map/endpoints/filter; minimum crossings then summed floor-integer centre-hop span then whole-path ordinal. Proxy is not visible route length.
comparisons.naturalLayout: Actual old/new seeded250 then1000 exports; different version/hash stated; identical camera/style, no marker jitter
comparisons.arity: Actual group membership if supplied; otherwise explicitly labeled geometric proxies

scope: CPU/browser art only; safe913 checkpoint and prior galleries frozen; no campaign/sensors/AI/diplomacy, paid generation, native/Unity/GPU or M2
filter: Mandatory explicit known node/edge lists; missing rejects/empty denies; full-map review supplies all; not persisted trusted permission

naturalContract.groupMeaning: Persisted generation provenance, not geometric connectivity or measured isolation

announcedNaming.status: Announced pre-consumer release rename; actual implementation pin pending
